workout.title: 10K final assessment
workout.notes: DRAFT / NOT APPROVED. Shared run rules in SOURCE.md apply. Flat measured course or track preferred. Record elapsed time, exact distance, route/surface, weather, splits, RPE and environment. Disable auto-pause. First 2 km controlled; km 3–7 even sustainable effort; assess at 7 km and increase only if able; commit in final kilometre. Use training evidence to select pace. If unwell/in pain, do not force the assessment; retain an unavailable result and review timing.
